B slides left, absorbs A, lands at 12-15 (end). D on the opposite side → freezes. Result: horizontal arm all g (merged at 12-15, D at 35-38), key #1.

The bottom end of the vertical arm: the last cell is 36-39. Just past V5 = 40-43, off the track. So the ring can't be placed → maybe the ring appears at V5's position? Or the merge can't happen.
   Alternative: select V5 (37,42): nearest = V2 (24-27), ring just past V2 upward = 18-21 (corner cell, empty). Click (19,42) → V5 slides up, absorbs V2, lands at 18-21 (corner = top end of vertical arm). V5's opposite side = below = nothing. Hmm — no dot on the opposite side → is it still a line clear? T10's line clear had an opposite-side dot (V5) and a landing at the end. Here: landing at the end (18-21 = top end), no opposite-side dot. Does the line clear trigger?
   In T7: landing at the end (E), no opposite-side dot → no line clear (dot stayed green). So probably no line clear here either → the merged dot stays green at the corner. Then the vertical arm: 1 green dot at the corner, no key.
Hmm. So the vertical arm can't produce a key unless there's a dot on the opposite side. To line-clear the vertical arm: select V2, land at the bottom end (just past V5 = off-track ✗) or select V5, land at the top end (no opposite-side dot ✗).
Wait, maybe I'm getting the line-clear condition wrong. Let me re-derive from T10: selected V2 (24-27), landed at 12-15 (top end, just past the corner), V5 (36-39) on the opposite side of the selected dot. Result: line clear (all vertical dots → g, key).
T7: selected C (29-32), landed at E (41-44, right end), opposite side of C = left side = A? A was already gone (consumed in T3). So no opposite-side dot → no line clear. ✓.

For the vertical arm: select V2, land at the bottom end: just past V5 = off-track. Unless "just past the nearest dot" wraps around, or the ring is placed at the last track cell (36-39 = V5's position)? Hmm.
Or select V5, land at the top end (18-21): opposite side of V5 = below = nothing → no line clear.
So the vertical arm can only be line-cleared if there are 3 dots on it (like T10: corner, V2, V5). Currently only 2 (V2, V5). So the vertical line clear requires first merging the horizontal arm's dot into the corner!
Plan:
1. Merge A+B into C: click A (19,18), click (19,30). → C(18,30), D(18,36), V2, V5.
2. Merge C+D into the corner: click C (19,30), click (19,42). → corner(18,42), V2, V5. (3 vertical dots!)
